project_identity.name: 0x0C-web_server
project_identity.scope: Introduction to web servers, focusing on Nginx installation, configuration, domain setup, and automation with Puppet.
project_identity.description: Covers web server concepts, Nginx, domain management, redirection, custom error pages, and Puppet automation.

technicalSkills: Understand what a web server is and its main role
Learn how to transfer files to a server using SCP
Install and configure Nginx on a server
Set up and configure domain names with DNS
Automate web server deployment with Puppet
Understand the difference between root and alias in Nginx
Configure server blocks for hosting multiple websites
Apply secure shell (SSH) knowledge for server management
